onepager: 52. Book of Business Cross-Sell Agent one-pager.pptx
note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. New wave-2 template distilled from a field pattern; prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Ingests a broker's book of business and profiles every account, line, premium and expiration in seconds
cases.prompt: A broker just sent over their book of business. What's in it?

cases.onepager_bullet: Resolves an industry class for every line and flags the ones it cannot classify instead of guessing
cases.prompt: Can you fill in the industry classes for those accounts and tell me which ones you couldn't figure out?

cases.onepager_bullet: Matches every line to the underwriting units with appetite and surfaces the white space on each account
cases.prompt: Which of these accounts fit our appetite, and where's the white space?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the appetite-confirmation note for each underwriting unit with its shortlist before anything is routed
cases.prompt: Ask our underwriting units to confirm they want these before we route anything.

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the broker confirmation so dead or already-placed accounts drop out before routing
cases.prompt: Now draft a note back to the broker to make sure none of these are dead or already placed.
must_include: out of business or already placed elsewhere

cases.onepager_bullet: Lays out a routing plan for each unit's sellers with follow-up dates timed ahead of each renewal
cases.prompt: The replies are in. Route what's left to the right sellers with follow-up dates.
must_include: renewed early with its current market

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
